Name: Padded
Description: Quilted layers of cloth and batting designed to soften blows.
Combat Implications: Provides AC 11 + Dexterity modifier. Imposes disadvantage on Stealth checks.

Name: Leather
Description: The breastplate and shoulder protectors of this armor are made of leather that has been stiffened by being boiled in oil.
Combat Implications: Provides AC 11 + Dexterity modifier.

Name: Studded Leather
Description: Tough but flexible leather reinforced with close-set rivets or spikes.
Combat Implications: Provides AC 12 + Dexterity modifier.

Name: Hide
Description: A crude armor consisting of thick furs and pelts.
Combat Implications: Provides AC 12 + Dexterity modifier (maximum 2).

Name: Chain Shirt
Description: A shirt of interlocking metal rings worn between layers of clothing or leather.
Combat Implications: Provides AC 13 + Dexterity modifier (maximum 2).

Name: Scale Mail
Description: A leather coat and leggings covered with overlapping pieces of metal.
Combat Implications: Provides AC 14 + Dexterity modifier (maximum 2). Imposes disadvantage on Stealth checks.

Name: Breastplate
Description: A fitted metal chest piece worn with supple leather, offering solid protection without restricting movement.
Combat Implications: Provides AC 14 + Dexterity modifier (maximum 2).

Name: Half Plate
Description: Shaped metal plates covering most of the wearer's body, leaving the legs relatively unprotected.
Combat Implications: Provides AC 15 + Dexterity modifier (maximum 2). Imposes disadvantage on Stealth checks.

Name: Ring Mail
Description: Leather armor with heavy rings sewn into it, offering cheap but bulky protection.
Combat Implications: Provides AC 14. Imposes disadvantage on Stealth checks.

Name: Chain Mail
Description: Interlocking metal rings covering the entire body, complete with gauntlets.
Combat Implications: Provides AC 16. Requires Strength 13. Imposes disadvantage on Stealth checks.

Name: Splint
Description: Armor made of narrow vertical strips of metal riveted to a backing of leather worn over cloth padding.
Combat Implications: Provides AC 17. Requires Strength 15. Imposes disadvantage on Stealth checks.

Name: Plate
Description: Shaped, interlocking metal plates to cover the entire body, custom-fitted for the wearer.
Combat Implications: Provides AC 18. Requires Strength 15. Imposes disadvantage on Stealth checks.

Name: Shield
Description: A protective board made of wood or metal, carried in one hand to deflect attacks.
Combat Implications: Provides a +2 bonus to AC.

Name: Spiked Armor
Description: A rugged suit of leather armor reinforced with metal spikes, heavily favored by Battlerager dwarves.
Combat Implications: Provides AC 14 + Dexterity modifier (maximum 2). Imposes disadvantage on Stealth checks. Used for spiked retribution attacks by specific subclasses.

Name: Buckler
Description: A small metal or wooden shield strapped to the forearm, leaving the hand free to hold light items or weapons.
Combat Implications: Provides a +1 bonus to AC. Can be used while holding a light weapon or item in the same hand, but cannot be used for two-handed weapon strikes.

Name: Tower Shield
Description: A massive wooden or metal shield nearly as tall as a person, offering superior portable cover.
Combat Implications: Provides a +3 bonus to AC. Requires Strength 15. Speed is reduced by 10 feet. Can be planted as an action to provide half cover.

Name: Bone Armor
Description: Armor crafted from the bones of massive beasts or monsters, often used by druids or tribal warriors lacking metalcraft.
Combat Implications: Provides AC 12 + Dexterity modifier (maximum 2). Functions similarly to Hide but typically has lower durability.

Name: Chitin Half-Plate
Description: Shaped plates harvested from giant insects, monstrosities, or Underdark creatures like hook horrors.
Combat Implications: Provides AC 15 + Dexterity modifier (maximum 2). Imposes disadvantage on Stealth checks. Desirable for druids as it provides Half-Plate protection without using metal.

Name: Gambeson
Description: A thick, heavily padded linen jacket. A more practical, less restrictive, and combat-ready version of basic padded armor.
Combat Implications: Provides AC 11 + Dexterity modifier. Unlike standard Padded armor, it does not impose disadvantage on Stealth checks.

Name: Silken Armor
Description: Tightly woven, alchemically treated giant spider silk that turns blades while feeling lighter than cloth.
Combat Implications: Provides AC 11 + Dexterity modifier. Can be worn under normal clothing without being noticed.

Name: Brigandine
Description: Sturdy canvas or leather garments lined with small rectangular steel plates riveted to the fabric.
Combat Implications: Provides AC 14 + Dexterity modifier (maximum 2). Does not impose disadvantage on Stealth checks, unlike Scale Mail.

Name: Lamellar
Description: Small rectangular plates of iron, leather, or bronze laced together into horizontal rows.
Combat Implications: Provides AC 13 + Dexterity modifier (maximum 2).

Name: Cuirass
Description: A piece of armor formed of a single or multiple pieces of metal or other rigid material covering the torso, lighter than a full breastplate.
Combat Implications: Provides AC 14 + Dexterity modifier (maximum 2).

Name: Banded Mail
Description: A classic armor style consisting of overlapping horizontal bands of metal sewn over a layer of chain or leather.
Combat Implications: Provides AC 16. Requires Strength 13. Imposes disadvantage on Stealth checks. Acts as a bridge between Chain Mail and Splint.

Name: Field Plate
Description: A more accessible, mass-produced version of full plate armor designed for army regulars and mercenaries rather than custom-fitted nobility.
Combat Implications: Provides AC 17. Requires Strength 15. Imposes disadvantage on Stealth checks.

Name: Targe
Description: A round, studded shield frequently equipped with a central spike, favored by skirmishers for close combat.
Combat Implications: Provides a +2 bonus to AC. Can often be used to make improvised melee attacks dealing 1d4 piercing damage.

Name: Kite Shield
Description: A teardrop-shaped shield designed to protect a rider's or infantryman's leading leg during combat.
Combat Implications: Provides a +2 bonus to AC. Often grants additional benefits against ranged attacks originating from the front.

Name: Pavise
Description: A massive, convex shield specifically designed for crossbowmen and archers to reload behind in relative safety.
Combat Implications: Provides a +2 bonus to AC while carried. As an action, it can be deployed into the ground to provide Half Cover (+2 AC and Dex saves) to a creature standing behind it, freeing their hands.
